# Spin-Glass and XORSAT Benchmarks

A repository for benchmark instances and solver conventions across dense, sparse, and lattice spin-glass models, plus XORSAT-oriented higher-order families. The documentation is organised into benchmark problem definitions, literature references, benchmark results, and implementation notes.

::: {.content-band .muted}
## Current Scope

| Area | Repository convention |
|---|---|
| Instance families | SK, EA 2D/3D, random regular graph, and 3-XORSAT |
| Instance storage | Text-readable coupling files under `benchmarks/<model>/N<size>/` |
| Generator contract | Deterministic generation from explicit parameters and seed |
| Solver contract | Standardized status, objective, assignment, and metrics |
| Publishing | Quarto website rendered from `docs/` and deployed through GitHub Pages |
:::
